stem_book: The pulleys and string shown in the figure are smooth and of negligible mass. A mass √2 m hangs at the middle of the string, which passes over two fixed pulleys and carries a mass m at each end. For the system to remain in equilibrium, the angle θ (between each string segment and the vertical at the middle mass) should be: (a) 0° (b) 30° (c) 45° (d) 60°
work: T = mg each side ⇒ 2mg cosθ = √2 mg ⇒ cosθ = 1/√2 ⇒ θ = 45°
